steps.sqlite:
UPDATE kit_sessions SET catalog_entry_id = (
  SELECT c.id FROM catalog_agents c
  WHERE c.slug = kit_sessions.agent_slug
    AND c.created_at <= kit_sessions.created_at
    AND (c.deleted_at IS NULL OR c.deleted_at > kit_sessions.created_at)
  ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
) WHERE agent_slug IS NOT NULL;

steps.sqlite:
CREATE TABLE kit_usage_limit_agent_months (
  catalog_entry_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  month TEXT NOT NULL,
  tokens INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  active_seconds REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  tokens_unknown INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  active_seconds_unknown INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (catalog_entry_id, month)
);
steps.mysql:
CREATE TABLE kit_usage_limit_agent_months (
  catalog_entry_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
  month VARCHAR(7) NOT NULL,
  tokens BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  active_seconds DOUBLE NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  tokens_unknown TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  active_seconds_unknown TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY (catalog_entry_id, month)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_bin;

steps.sqlite:
INSERT INTO kit_usage_limit_agent_months (catalog_entry_id, month, tokens, active_seconds, tokens_unknown, active_seconds_unknown)
SELECT owner.catalog_entry_id, ledger.month, ledger.tokens, ledger.active_seconds, ledger.tokens_unknown, ledger.active_seconds_unknown
FROM kit_usage_limit_agent_months_legacy AS ledger
JOIN (
  SELECT agent_slug, MIN(catalog_entry_id) AS catalog_entry_id, MIN(created_at) AS first_session_at
  FROM (
    SELECT agent_slug, catalog_entry_id, created_at FROM kit_sessions WHERE agent_slug IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT agent_slug, catalog_entry_id, created_at FROM kit_session_usage
  ) AS session_history
  GROUP BY agent_slug
  HAVING COUNT(*) = COUNT(catalog_entry_id) AND COUNT(DISTINCT catalog_entry_id) = 1
) AS owner ON owner.agent_slug = ledger.agent_slug
JOIN catalog_agents AS catalog ON catalog.id = owner.catalog_entry_id AND catalog.slug = ledger.agent_slug
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM catalog_agents AS other_entry WHERE other_entry.slug = catalog.slug AND other_entry.id <> catalog.id
) AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM kit_usage_limit_agent_months_legacy AS earlier_month
  WHERE earlier_month.agent_slug = ledger.agent_slug AND earlier_month.month < SUBSTR(owner.first_session_at, 1, 7)
) AND NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM kit_usage_limit_agent_days_legacy AS earlier_day
  WHERE earlier_day.agent_slug = ledger.agent_slug AND earlier_day.day < SUBSTR(owner.first_session_at, 1, 10)
);

) AS owner ON owner.agent_slug = ledger.agent_slug
JOIN catalog_agents AS catalog ON catalog.id = owner.catalog_entry_id AND catalog.slug = ledger.agent_slug
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM catalog_agents AS other_entry WHERE other_entry.slug = catalog.slug AND other_entry.id <> catalog.id

);
